Edwards Lifesciences (NYSE&#58; EW) </font><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:200%">today announced the appointment of Theodora (&#8220;Doretta&#8221;) Mistras as the company&#8217;s corporate vice president and chief financial officer (CFO), effective at the end of May. Mistras will succeed Scott Ullem, who announced in October his planned transition from the CFO role.</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:200%">          Mistras joins Edwards from Viatris, where she has served as CFO since March 2024, leading the company&#8217;s global finance organization and overseeing financial planning, reporting and operational finance across a complex, global business. Prior to Viatris, she was a managing director in healthcare investment banking at Citigroup Global Markets, and earlier in her career held senior leadership roles in healthcare investment banking at Goldman Sachs. Mistras brings decades of healthcare leadership experience helping guide corporate boards and executive teams on corporate finance, strategy and investor relations. She holds a bachelor&#8217;s degree in international studies from the University of Pennsylvania and a bachelor&#8217;s degree in economics from the Wharton School.</font></div><div style="text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:200%">&#8220;We are very pleased to welcome Doretta to Edwards as our next CFO,&#8221; said Bernard Zovighian, Edwards&#8217; CEO. &#8220;Doretta&#8217;s broad experience will be instrumental as we execute our differentiated strategy. We look forward to her leadership as we continue to invest in innovation, and also deliver distinguished and durable financial results and long-term value to patients, customers, shareholders and the broader healthcare ecosystem.&#8221;</font></div><div style="text-indent:36pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:200%">Ullem has served as Edwards&#8217; CFO since 2014. &#8220;We would like to once again thank Scott for his outstanding leadership, partnership and impact,&#8221; Zovighian added. &#8220;His commitment to a thoughtful transition and his continued support as a strategic advisor in the months ahead </font></div><div style="height:27pt;position:relative;width:100%"><div style="bottom:0;position:absolute;width:100%"><div style="padding-left:13.5pt;text-indent:-13.5pt"><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%"> </font></div><div><font><br></font></div></div></div><hr style="page-break-after:always"><div style="min-height:45pt;width:100%"><div style="text-align:center"><font><br></font></div><div style="text-align:right"><font><br></font></div><div><font><br></font></div></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:12pt;font-weight:400;line-height:200%">reflects the discipline and continuity that have long defined Edwards&#8217; approach to leadership. We are grateful for Scott&#8217;s numerous contributions over the years that have helped to strengthen our company both strategically and financially.&#8221;   </font></div><div><font><br></font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:700;line-height:112%">About Edwards Lifesciences</font></div><div><font style="color:#000000;font-family:'Arial',sans-serif;font-size:11pt;font-weight:400;line-height:112%">Edwards Lifesciences is the leading global structural heart innovation company, driven by a passion to improve patient lives. Through breakthrough technologies, world-class evidence and partnerships with clinicians and healthcare stakeholders, our employees are inspired by our patient-focused culture to deliver life-changing innovations to those who need them most.
